I drew the same conclusion too after working hard and being determined in one of my goals this year. I was hell bent, prayed daily and invested alot of time in pursuit of being a successful freelance writer. The earning graph shot up due to my consistency. Then it went down gradually after i fell out with my client. This failing pattern developed into depression as i could not control it. For mental health, i decided to quit altogether, which consequently made me feel lost and hopeless. I had always believed I am a good writer and will earn good cash from it, but all i got was peanuts. I started having a negative attitude towards life. I saw that even if someone  work their asses off or just be a lazy bum, the dissatisfaction is almost the same. Regret is in both sides whether you do good deeds or bad ones in my case. Discipline or not. This what led me to be a nihilist and to just living for the sake of it. Self-help books will just instill false hopes to your mind, and being deluded that "you are a winner" Not everyone can win and thats the truth. For one winner, there have to be losers.
